heading: MIGII Generator Protection System - Legacy

text: The MIGII, part of the M II Family of economical and highly functional digital relays, provides comprehensive protection for small generators. It can also be used to protect small motors, or as a backup protection for transformers, and large motors. To complement its protection and control features, the MIGIIs user-friendly controls and plug and play EnerVista compatible setup software make this product very easy to configure and use.
